name: mobile-development
description: Canonical mobile development guidance with explicitly added, on-demand Appium tooling.

interface.shortDescription: Develop and test local Android and iOS surfaces.
interface.longDescription: One Appium MCP control plane for both mobile platforms: an Android emulator running natively on Windows, and an iOS Simulator inside the existing VMware macOS guest driven over the private virtual network. Launch apps, inspect the element tree, tap and type, capture screenshots and screen recordings, and compare the same flow across platforms.
defaultPrompt: Open the app on the Android emulator and walk the main flow.
Run the same flow on the iOS Simulator and compare.
Capture a screen recording of this bug reproducing.
